newsitem.title: FINLAND: ERM OPPONENT TOPS POLL AHEAD FINNISH EURO - MP VOTE.
newsitem.headline: ERM OPPONENT TOPS POLL AHEAD FINNISH EURO - MP VOTE.

text.p: A new opinion poll put the Left-Wing Alliance party's European Parliament candidate Esko Seppanen as the top vote-puller in Finland's Sunday election, local media reported on Friday.

Seppanen, who as a central bank supervisor voted against pegging the markka to Europe's exchange rate mechanism ERM last Friday, soared to a support figure of almost 11 percent in the poll for television news, newspaper Demari said.

That put Seppanen ahead of leaders in earlier polls, Kirsi Piha of the conservative National Coalition Party, Paavo Vayrynen of the Centre Party and Jorn Donner of the Social Democrats, whose support ratings were around 7-8 percent, the paper said.
The poll, conducted last weekend, also measured party support in the European parliament ballot.

The governing Social Democrats led the field with 24.2 percent of the electorate. The opposition Centre Party was backed by 21.9 percent, and the National Coalition -- also in the government -- by 21.6 percent.

Support for the Left-Wing Alliance, a coalition partner in the SDP-led government, was put at 11.2 percent. The other junior coalition parties, the Green Party and the Swedish People's Party, got 6.7 percent and 3.6 percent, respectively.

According to the poll, the SDP would get five Euro MPs, up one, the Centre Party and the conservatives four each -- meaning the centrists would lose one seat -- the Left-Wing Alliance two, up one, and the Green Party one seat.
Among the smaller opposition groups, support for the Progressive Finnish Party ("Young Finns") was put at 4.5 percent and for the Christian League at 3.7 percent.
The European parliament opinion poll figures are broadly in line with recent opinion poll ratings for the political parties ahead of the local government elections, which will also be held on Sunday.
The polling agency Taloustutkimus Oy surveyed voters on their candidate choices last weekend after the markka was pegged to ERM.
